svg.text: Latent self-calibration passes; edited-action phase is not recovered
Final latent only. Heatmap: cosine distance; cyan: frozen monotone path; magenta: event midpoint pairs.
Markers use existing frozen video event intervals, rounded to nearest bin center for this diagram only.
A diagonal latent path is not a measurement of zero pixel-level action delay. No RGB / VAE / DiT loaded.
